Connection settings

Agent tab supports Instagram, X, Reddit, Facebook, LinkedIn and YouTube. It can navigate, read and analyze content. Posting, messaging and form entry are not available.

Connect once and allow access if Chrome asks. Maverick opens in an existing tab in this profile and connects automatically after sign-in. The agent uses the shared tab; keep it and Maverick open. A separate window is needed for desktop apps and other browser profiles. Cookies and passwords are not sent to Maverick.
